Commentary.Commentary: The players are out in the middle. Beth Mooney and Alyssa Healy are the openers. Renuka Singh will start for India. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now the target is not a big one and Australia have a really powerful batting line-up, they will back themselves to chase this down on a wicket which seems very good to bat on. India on the other hand, will have to bowl really well if they are to have a chance. They need early wickets or the game will drift away from them quite quickly.

Except for the middle overs Australia's bowling was very good! They began well with the ball as they managed to keep it tight but they stuggled when Verma got going, the boundaries were flowing then. However, they came back stronly once she fell. They have done well to keep the Indians to below 160. Jess Jonassen was brilliant with a four-fer but the likes of Megan Schutt and Ashleigh Gardner were also very good.

That innings from Kaur has taken India to a competitive total. However, it will still be Australia who will be the happier of the two sides as at one point, India threatened to cross over 170-run mark. Especially when Kaur and Verma were at the crease. The two were dealing in boundaries, especially Verma. When she was out there, India were scoring at over 8 per over. Once she fell though, wickets kept falling at regular intervals and due to that, Kaur had to hold her self back. She though was there till the last over, she ensured her side got over that 150-run mark and also scored a half ton but we believe, India have a score which is slightly under par.

OUT! CAUGHT! So, Megan Schutt finishes with another wicket and India finish with 154 on the board. It is short delivery on off. Singh pulls it but gets a top edge. The ball goes straight into the hands of Tahlia McGrath at deep square leg and India finish with 154/8 after 20 overs!
Commentary.Howout: c Tahlia McGrath b Megan Schutt

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! BOWLED! End of a fantastic knock from the Indian skipper. This is a low full toss on leg. Kaur gets a bit across the line and looks to flick it. However, the ball hits the outside half of her blade and goes onto hit the stumps. Megan Schutt gets her first wicket and Indian skipper walks back to the standing ovation. Meghna Singh is the next batter in.
A full delivery on middle Kaur slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
A fuller delivery on off. Kaur pushes it to the off side.

FOUR! Fifty for Harmanpreet Kaur! What a captain's knock this is! Brilliant under pressure. A fuller delivery on off. Kaur plays her favourite shot as she gets a bit across and sweeps it towards the square leg fence for a boundary.
In the air...but safe! On a length, around off. Yadav makes a bit of room and just chips it uppishly towards mid off. A single taken.
SIX! Here she goes! This is what India need! A flighted delivery on off. Kaur dances down the track and hits it powerfully over long on for a biggie.
A quicker one around off. Kaur looks to sweep it but misses. The ball hits her on the helmet. The physio is out and after a mandatory concussion test, Kaur looks fine.
A fuller delivery on middle. Yadav skips down the track and works it uppishly to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off. Yadav drives it back to the bowler.

OUT! CAUGHT! Harleen Deol tries to hit it in the same direction again but fails to do so this time. This is a bit shorter in length and on off. Deol makes room and looks to go over extra-cover. However, she does not get any timing on this one and ends up giving an easy catch to Tahlia McGrath at covers. Radha Yadav is the next batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Tahlia McGrath b Jess Jonassen

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Lovely shot! Tossed up, around off. Deol makes a bit of room and goes inside-out over extra-cover for a boundary.

FOUR! That is a brilliant shot! Kaur moves towards the off side. King bowls it short and outside off. Kaur pulls it towards deep mid-wicket, in the gap and another boundary. End of a good over. Kaur holds the key if they are to reach 160.
A single as this is pushed through covers.
Another sweep, it is hit through square leg for one.
Kaur moves away, King bowls a yorker. Kaur does well to jam it out.
FOUR! This time the sweep shot is nailed! On middle, this is swept brilliantly through mid-wicket. It is in the gap and a boundary it is.
On the shorter side on middle. Kaur looks to pull it but gets a top edge. The ball goes in the air but falls behind the short fine leg fielder. Two runs taken.
On a length, on off. Harleen Deol blocks it out.

Mooney with a great effort in the deep! A full delivery on middle. Harleen Deol lifts it straight down the ground. Mooney runs to her left and dives. Get a hand on it. However, the ball does not stick and the batters run two.
A full delivery on the pads. Kaur flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Kaur is key for India here! On the shorter side, on off. Kaur pulls it to the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Keeps it a tad short, around off. Kaur looks to paddle it away but misses. The ball hits high on her pads.
A fuller delivery, around off. Kaur drives it to covers.
On the shorter side, on off. Deol punches it to covers.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Two in the over and Jess Jonassen is showing her class with the ball yet again!. This is slower through the air, on off. Sharma looks to work it towards the leg side. However, she does so a bit early and ends up hitting it straight back to the bowler. Jess Jonassen takes an easy catch off her own bowling and India lose their fifth wicket now. Harleen Deol is the next batter in.
Floated up, on off. Kaur drives it to long off for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Kaur drives it back to the bowler.
A tossed up delivery on middle. Sharma works it to square leg for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jemimah Rodrigues departs! This is tossed up on off. Jemimah Rodrigues skips down the track and looks to hit it down the ground. However, she does not get the elevation on this shot and ends up hitting it straight to Beth Mooney at mid off. She takes the catch easily and India lose another. Deepti Sharma is the next batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Jess Jonassen

Commentary.Commentary: A fuller delivery on off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it wide of mid off for a single.
Pushes it quicker and around off. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to work it towards the leg side but misses.
On the shorter side, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues blocks it off the back foot.
A fuller delivery on middle. Kaur skips down the track and pushes it to mid off for a single.
FOUR! Lovely placement again! This is shorter in length again and outside off this time. Kaur waits for it and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely played! On the shorter side, on off. Kaur rocks back and pulls it to the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Slower through the air, on off. Kaur slog-sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.

Big appeal for an LBW! The umpire though is not interested and Australia Women take a review! King tosses this up, around off. It turns away a bit and hits Kaur on the back leg as she tries to slog-sweep it.  The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracking shows that the impact it umpire's call and the original decision will stay. Kaur will continue.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to long off for a single.
Slower through the air, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Wonderful stroke! This is floated up, in the air outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues leans forward and lifts it inside-out over extra-cover for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues works it to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
This one stays a touch low! Shorter and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues looks to cut but is beaten.
Short and this is pulled through square leg for another single.
How has that missed the stumps! Shorter and on middle, Kaur looks to pull, she misses. The extra bounce saves her as it goes over the off pole.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
A dot to end! On middle, this is swept but to square leg.
Jemimah Rodrigues is off the mark! On off, she pushes it down to long off for one.

AN APPEAL FOR A CAUGHT BEHIND! The umpire shakes her head but it is reviewed. OUT! There is a spike on Ultra Edge and Australia get the big wicket of Verma. Timely one as Verma was getting a move and hitting boundaries at will. She falls two short of a half ton! On the pads. Verma looks to sweep but it goes off something to the keeper. An appeal but turned down. Alyssa Healy seems confident and wants it to be reviewed. Her skipper does and it is a good one as the umpire now she has to overturn her decision. Can Australia press on from here? Jemimah Rodrigues walks out to the middle now.
Commentary.Howout: c Alyssa Healy b Jess Jonassen

Commentary.Commentary: On off, this is pushed to covers.
That is another good save but not good running from India! On middle, this is swept through square leg. The fielder in the deep, runs to her right, dives and keeps it down to one. Saves three.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Three in a row to end and four in the over in total! India on the charge! On a length, this is pulled wide of mid on. Mooney runs there and dives but it is just out of reach. Trickles away.
FOUR! Down the ground now! Verma is dealing in boundaries! On middle, this is thumped down the ground and into the long on fence.
FOUR! Jammed out brilliantly! Verma in full flow now! A yorker on the pads, she jams it fine on the leg side and the ball races away to the fence.

That is brilliant fielding and it is only one in the end! Short and on the body, this is pulled hard towards fine leg. The fielder in the deep, runs to her right and pushes it back in. Shocking it is just one. Kaur thought it was a boundary for sure.
Length and on off, Kaur blocks it out.
FOUR! That is played very fine! Poor ball and another over which starts with a boundary! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side. No chance of stopping that.
On the stumps, this is flicked to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
This is played through square leg for one.
Another scoop, not as good as the last one so just the one.
FOUR! Lovely shot! She goes down on one knee and plays the paddle scoop, it goes fine on the leg side for a boundary.
Harmanpreet Kaur is the next batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Australia Women were unlucky in the previous over but have found a luck breakthrough this time around. This is tossed up on middle. Bhatia pushes it to mid on and sets off for a single. She was just watching the ball and not her partner and that created the confusion. She runs halfway down the pitch and then sees her partner is not interested. She tries to turn around but slips and in the meanwhile the throw comes to the batter's end from Grace Harris and Alyssa Healy whips the bails off. Yastika Bhatia is well out of her crease.
Another single as this is worked through square leg. Excellent over for the Indian side.
On off, this is tossed up, it is pushed down to long off for one.

NOT OUT! Alyssa Healy did not knock the bails off with the hand she had the ball in! Very unfortunate but superb effort from her. Down the leg side. Verma looks to flick but misses. She loses her balance. Healy collects the ball brilliantly and takes the bails off. Her initial reaction was "OHHHH!" and then she looked at the heavens in dismay. She then looked at the square leg umpire, Redfern, and immediately signalled, that she had missed the stumping. Redfern looked at her, asked her enquiringly but went upstairs for proper official confirmation. Replays show that she knocks the bails off with the hand in which the ball wasn't there. She does try with the other hand but both the bails were off. Wide signaled in the end.

Is that stumped? Alyssa Healy does not look much confident though. Ohh...she seems to have whipped the bails by a wrong hard. She had a ball in her left hand but she whipped the bails with the right hand first. Then she did with left hand with the ball in hand but she needed to uproot the stumps with that.
Lovely fielding! That could have been four boundaries in a row! Outside off, this is carved over point. The fielder from point hares after it, dives and pushes it back in. Saves two for her side.
FOUR! EDGY! Momentum shifting. Luck too. Three in a row now! On off, Verma looks to push at it, it goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence.
FOUR DOWN THE GROUND! Runs flowing now for India! A full toss on middle, this is creamed down the ground, no chance of stopping that despite a good effort from long on.
FOUR! Whipped away! That chance may cost Australia! On the pads, this is whipped through mid-wicket for a boundary.

This lands safe! Actually it lands between covers and long off. That was a chance.Jess Jonassen slows it up, Verma steps out but is early in the loft. She hits it up in the air. Meg Lanning from covers runs after it and so does the fielder from long off. In the end, it lands safe. Both were probably worried of a coliision. A single in the end.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap nicely! The slog sweep is out, she drags it from outside off, hits it between long on and deep mid-wicket for another boundary.
Verma steps out but does not get to the pitch of it. She mistimes it towards deep mid-wicket for one more.
Floats it up on off, this is driven hard but to covers.
Jess Jonassen is into the attack now.
On the bounce! Tossed up on middle, Verma looks to go downtown, it goes more off the inner half but lands short of long on. Another single. 9 from Alana King's first.
Slightly shorter, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Verma steps out and then hits it down to long on for one.
On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Takes one now as she works it through mid-wicket.
FOUR! Tickled nice and fine! On the pads, Verma works it towards the fine leg fence. It races away. Good start to the over.
Schutt with a fullish length again, angling into middle. Verma works it to mid-wicket for a single. India Women are 35/1 after the Powerplay!
Angling into off from wide of the crease. Verma defends it towards the off side.
Again a full delivery on off. Verma drives it crisply to mid off.
FOUR! Verma finds the gap this time! Megan Schutt keeps bowling full and Verma this time lifts it past mid off for a boundary. She is a dangerous player and India need her to go big today.
Very full again, on off. Verma drives again but finds the mid off fielder.
A fuller delivery on off. Verma drives it to covers.
Fails to find the gap again! Pushes it quicker on middle. Bhatia reverse-sweeps it to the cover fielder.
Slower through the air, on off. Bhatia skips down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
An arm ball this time on middle. Bhatia works it to mid-wicket.
A fuller delivery on off. Verma drills it to mid off. A single taken as the fielder stops it with a dive.
On the shorter side and flatter, on off. Verma punches it to covers.
FOUR! Like Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma also attacks Ashleigh Gardner straight away! This is tossed up on off. Verma dances down the track and hits it straight down the ground for a boundary.
In the air...but safe! A fullish delivery on off. Bhatia drives but drives it bit aerially and luckliy for her it falls short of the mid off fielder.
Short and wide outside off. Bhatia slashes her bat hard towards it but gets beaten again.
Lands on a length and outside off. Bhatia tries to punch it but misses.
Yastika Bhatia is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Darcie Brown strikes and gets rid of dangerous Smriti Mandhana! She was looking so good out there in the middle but one falsh shot and that brings her downfall. Brown bowls it full but wider outside off. Smriti Mandhana goes chasing for it and the ball catches the outside edge of her blade. It goes to Alyssa Healy behind the stumps and she takes it comfortably.
Commentary.Howout: c Alyssa Healy b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Down the ground this time, class from Smriti Mandhana! Goes fuller on middle. Smriti Mandhana makes a bit of room and lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana is looking in mood today! Brown bangs it short on off. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and pulls it towards the square leg fence for a boundary.
On the shorter side, on off. Verma pushes it towards the off side.

Slower through the air, on middle. Verma skips down the track and looks to work it towards the leg side. However, he gets a leading edge as he plays it a tad early and the ball goes a bit aerially towards covers.
A flatter delivery on middle. Verma defends it.
Shimmies down the track again. This is on middle and Smriti Mandhana lifts it towards wide long on for a single.
A flatter one and tad shorter on middle. Smriti Mandhana just works it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana greets Ashleigh Gardner with a boundary! Tossed up on off. Smriti Mandhana skips down the track and hits it over mid off for a boundary.
Fullish length again, it is outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it towards deep point for a single.
A full delivery on off. Smriti Mandhana walks down the pitch again and drives it to mid off.
Lands on a length, angling into middle. Verma defends it towards the leg side and takes a quick single to get off the mark.

Dropped! A fullish delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana walks forward and drives it uppishly towards point. The fielder there jumps and gets a hand to it. However, the ball does not stick and falls away from her. A single taken.
FOUR! Nice placement! An overpitched delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
On a length and outside off. Smriti Mandhana walks forward and looks to punch it away but misses.
Megan Schutt to start from the other end.
Back of a length, around leg. Smriti Mandhana pulls it towards the fine leg fence. However, the fielder in the deep dives to her left and stops it. Just a single.
Lovely delivery! Lands on a good length and seams back in from off. Smriti Mandhana looks to pull it but gets beaten. The ball just goes over the stumps and back to the keeper.
Shortens the length a bit, on middle. Smriti Mandhana defends it towards the leg side.
FOUR! India and Smriti Mandhana are underway in style! A low full toss, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it crisply through cover-point for a boundary.
Pulls her length back, on off. Smriti Mandhana defends it off the back foot this time.
Brown starts with a fullish delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives but straight to mid off.

We are all set to begin! The Australia Women players are out there in the middle. Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana are the openers for India Women. This is a huge occasion for all these players. It will be Darcie Brown who will start with the ball for Australia Women. Here we go...

So, India are batting first in this all-important clash and it can well prove out be a good thing for India, especially against a team like Australia who have lot of firepower in their arsenal. If India can dominate the Powerplay, it can set the momentum for the whole game and with three spinners in the playing XI, a good score on the board can put India in a strong position.
Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning (C), Tahlia McGrath, Rachael Haynes, Ashleigh Gardner, Grace Harris, Jess Jonassen, Alana King, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown.

India Women (Playing XI) - Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Yastika Bhatia (WK), Jemimah Rodrigues, Harleen Deol, Deepti Sharma, Radha Yadav, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Meghna Singh, Renuka Singh.

Meg Lanning, the skipper of Australia Women says that this will be an enjoyable experience and will be a good challenge. Tells that they have played in big tournaments and they want to win every game. Mentions that they are used to the pressure and they are excited about the challenge.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women says that they will bat first and tells that the wicket looks good and it might slow down a bit so they are batting first. Tells that this team looks very positive and they have worked hard after the World Cup. Informs that they are playing with three spinners, a keeper and rest are batters.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Harmanpreet Kaur. India Women have elected to BAT first

India, on the other hand, too have some exciting talent in their ranks. The opening combination of Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma can provide India with explosive starts and that will be a critical factor against a team like Australia. They will be surely missing the services of the hard-hitting all-rounder Pooja Vastrakar in this game but India do have enough quality at their disposal to challenge Australia. Can India make a statement here with a win against the mighty Aussies? Or will Australia dominate the proceedings? Let’s find out. Toss and team news in a bit.
